command:
cat <<'SCRIPT' > /tmp/setup_zram.sh
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: install zram-generator"
sudo -n dnf install -y zram-generator

echo "STEP: configure zram device"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf.d
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[zram0]
zram-size = 512
compression-algorithm = zstd
swap-priority = 100
EOF

echo "STEP: reload systemd and start zram device"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl restart systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
sleep 2

echo "STEP: verify zram swap active"
swapon --show
echo ---
cat /proc/swaps
echo ---
systemctl is-enabled systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service || true
echo ---
zramctl || true

command:
cat <<'SCRIPT' > /tmp/reset_zram.sh
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: current zram state"
lsmod | grep zram || true
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm 2>/dev/null || true
swapon --show

echo "STEP: swapoff zram0 if active"
sudo -n swapoff /dev/zram0 2>/dev/null || true

echo "STEP: reset zram0 device"
echo 1 | sudo -n tee /sys/block/zram0/reset >/dev/null

echo "STEP: retry systemd-zram-setup"
sudo -n systemctl reset-failed systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service || true
sudo -n systemctl restart systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
sleep 2

echo "STEP: verify"
swapon --show
echo ---
cat /proc/swaps
echo ---
zramctl
echo ---
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
